name: Hana Cole
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one static full-body 2D fighting-game character sprite.
Primary request: Hana Cole, scientist from Gears 5: Hivebusters, using the supplied official Gears 5 character and store images as appearance references. Use ONLY the woman Hana from these references; ignore Ukkon, backgrounds, all interface panels and text.
Subject: one young adult Black woman with the exact reference hairstyle of short black locs tied and swept back with a few hanging near the face, serious intelligent expression and athletic modest build. Her official pale off-white fitted long laboratory jacket has a high collar, dark gray shoulder and upper-sleeve panels, central front zipper, a gray belt with rectangular buckle over the waist, split long jacket tails to upper thighs, fitted dark trousers, practical dark boots and a small cyan-lit wrist device. Keep this lab outfit, not COG plated armor.
Pose: full-body three-quarter SIDE view facing screen RIGHT, balanced neutral guard pose, hands relaxed but ready, unarmed to keep her laboratory identity clear. One subject and one still pose only.
Framing: at least 8 percent empty transparent margin above head and below boots and to each side. Full body from hair tips to soles, nothing cropped.
Style: polished detailed hand-painted 2D game cutout with realistic Gears proportions and materials, crisp readable silhouette, neutral controlled light.
Background: true transparent alpha only, no floor, no ground shadow, no haze, no glow cloud, no vignette, no scene.
Constraints: closely preserve the supplied official face/hair/clothing identity; no weapon or gear invented, no lab props, no second person, no text, no logo, no panel, no frame, no animation, no action sequence, no spritesheet.
reference_scope: Hivebusters concept author page consulted; final Gears 5 Scientist Hana official publisher store and reveal images visually inspected. These provide the lab outfit rather than unverified concept-only details.

qa.visual_review: One adult Hana, full-body lab outfit, locs hairstyle, pale jacket, dark yoke, belt, wrist device and boots. Unarmed neutral fixed stance. Face and cloth geometry remain reinterpretation.
qa.alpha_review: PNG RGBA with genuine alpha. All corners transparent; outside coverage measured. RGB halo in raw preview is not proof of opaque background.
